title: Monaghan Medical: Monaghan Medical Attains ISO 14001 Certification
summary: Monaghan Medical announced ISO 14001 certification for its environmental management system. Entity use: Monaghan Medical's ISO 14001 announcement and company profile document management controls around its Plattsburgh manufacturing operation. They precede or accompany the later MEP output case but do not establish a production, quality, cost, or environmental causal effect.
key_findings: The company describes risk-based management, continual improvement, waste diversion, and greenhouse-gas reduction objectives.
Temporal role: The company attained ISO 14001 certification and set continual-improvement, waste-diversion, and emissions-reduction objectives.
Attribution: Certification and environmental objectives are company-attributed; the output result is company- and MEP-attributed.
